messages:
jamie: Quick bench update on Starlane-13b (int8 vs int6). Did a 24h slice run for longform QA + summarization. Key takeaways below, attaching the quick scorecard.
jamie: Summary: int6 = ~17% token cost reduction, p50 latency ~8% lower. But we saw a 3.6% hit on longform QA recall (answers that need >512 tokens context). Short-context summarization unchanged.
ravi: Numbers please — unit cost and sample sizes?
jamie: ran 12k samples (mix: 60% QA, 40% summarization). Token-econ (hosted profile): int8 = $0.0087 /k token; int6 = $0.0072 /k token. Throughput (tokens/s on ded infra gpus): int8 p50=2200, int6 p50=2380. p95 tail similar (+/-2%).
linh: how are we measuring recall? any eval set drift vs prod prompts?
jamie: recall = top-1 exact-match on our longform QA benchmark (subset A, 3k samples). We also did priming sensitivity test — int6 degrades more when prompts include long examples (>5-shot). Looks like kvcache quant noise on attention for concat lengths >1k.
sasha: hmm — that 3.6% could matter for GTN feature (document QA). Does it correlate with particular prompt styles or tokenizers?
jamie: correlates with heavy long-context examples and few-shot priming. Tokenizer diffs negligible. Example failure mode: model drops correct span when multiple similar passages present.
ops-bot: CI: model-starlane-int6 smoke passed (latency OK) — 1765009900
ravi: product asks for recommendation: do we route traffic to int6 for cheap queries only? Suggest split by length and feature? propose flags?
jamie: Proposed routing: default->int8; route to int6 when: estimated output tokens < 300 AND request type != "doc-qa". Add a soft canary: 10% traffic for short-summary routes, monitor recall and CTR for 48h.
linh: for Dedicated we can also enable hybrid batching (larger batch size) for int6 to maximize cost wins without latency regression. But need to watch KV cache hit rate.
sasha: also recommend setting a priming-guard: if prompt contains >3 examples OR context length >800, force int8.
jamie: quick scorecard I posted below (raw numbers):

```
metric                 | int8   | int6   | delta
-----------------------|--------|--------|------
unit_cost ($/k tok)    | 0.0087 | 0.0072 | -17%
p50 latency (ms)      | 455    | 418    | -8%
p95 latency (ms)      | 980    | 1000   | +2%
longform QA recall (%) | 78.4   | 74.8   | -3.6 pp
throughput (tokens/s)  | 2200   | 2380   | +8%
kvcache hit (long)     | 0.63   | 0.58   | -5 pp
```

jamie: recommendation for GTN/product: opt-in routing flag on product side -> call with feature_hint: {"type":"summary","max_output":200} to allow int6. For doc-qa keep int8.
ravi: ok. Action items: (1) implement routing rules + priming-guard flag (eng-platform) (2) add 48h canary dashboard: recall by slice, CTR, cost delta (observability) (3) follow-up eval after canary for A/B sign-off.
linh: I'll add a lightweight eval job to snapshot priming-sensitive examples and alert if recall drop >2% on canary.
sasha: product: we'll add feature_hint to GTN SDK and rollout to 25% of short-summary users after canary.
jamie: filing short runbook in #eng-ml with example gating config. ping me if you want the full slice CSV.
ops-bot: Deploy plan ticket created: ST-1192 (canary routing) - 1765010400
